tools_helpful.evidence: Mechanical pass produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md with every scenario/file triaged and marked done; deferredCount=0 (session-log.txt:323).

tools_problematic.problem: Its background-task check only asserts that a windows.backgroundTasks <Extension> exists. This scenario used the IN-PROCESS task model (TaskEntryPoint omitted) and the manifest DID declare the extension, so the check PASSED — yet the Run control was still dead at runtime. A green validator gave false confidence.
tools_problematic.evidence: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1:388-398 passes when 'windows.backgroundTasks' present; Package.appxmanifest:31-42 declares it; migration-score.json scenarios 3&4 verdict=partial (dead Run).

tool_limitations.limitation: No detection of the in-process background-task variant: BackgroundTaskBuilder with no TaskEntryPoint assignment, dispatched via App.OnBackgroundActivated. In WinUI 3 (Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application) there is no OnBackgroundActivated, so an in-process task can never fire and registration itself typically fails with an HRESULT the UWP sample's narrow catch does not handle.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Extend the background-task branch: when retained BackgroundTaskBuilder code has NO TaskEntryPoint assignment (in-process model), FAIL/WARN unless an OnBackgroundActivated handler exists, and point at the in-process guidance.

failed_apis.why_tried: Faithful port of the UWP BluetoothAdvertisement Scenario 3/4 in-process background watcher/publisher.
failed_apis.root_cause: WinUI 3's Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no OnBackgroundActivated override, so the in-process task activation model does not exist. BackgroundExecutionManager.RequestAccessAsync()/builder.Register() on a desktop WinUI 3 app fails with an HRESULT other than the E_DEVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE the sample catches; because RunButton_Click is async void and RequestAccessAsync is outside the try, the failure is swallowed and no status is shown.
failed_apis.fix: Convert the in-process task to the out-of-process model (assign a string TaskEntryPoint) OR at minimum broaden the catch to catch(Exception), move RequestAccessAsync inside the guard, and always NotifyUser a status so the control is never silently dead.

special_apis.api: In-process background tasks (BackgroundTaskBuilder without TaskEntryPoint + App.OnBackgroundActivated + windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer)
special_apis.special_handling: Has no WinUI 3 equivalent — Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application exposes no OnBackgroundActivated. Must be re-hosted as an out-of-process task (string TaskEntryPoint) or reworked; simply carrying the manifest inProcessServer/backgroundTasks extension is not enough.

errors_encountered.error: Scenario 3/4 Run button dead: RequestAccessAsync completes, no status text, Stop stays disabled, no task registered.
errors_encountered.root_cause: In-process background task registration fails at runtime on WinUI 3 (no OnBackgroundActivated dispatch; identity/activation differs from UWP); the failure HRESULT is not E_DEVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE so the sample's narrow catch misses it and the async void handler swallows it.
errors_encountered.fix: Port to out-of-process model and/or broaden the registration catch + always surface a status.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Code compiled and validator passed, but the background Run controls silently do nothing at runtime.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a — agent marked both files 'migrate-with-adaptation → done' (MIGRATION-MAPPING.md:14-15) with no adaptation for the missing in-process activation.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The skill's Background Tasks section only covers the out-of-process model, so the agent had no signal that the in-process variant (TaskEntryPoint omitted + OnBackgroundActivated) is unsupported in WinUI 3.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — shipped as a dead control (score 75, two partials).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Adding an in-process background-task subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md and a validator branch that flags TaskEntryPoint-less BackgroundTaskBuilder code lacking OnBackgroundActivated.

missing_tooling.need: Validator detection of the in-process background-task model.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The two partial (dead-control) background scenarios; the existing check passed and hid the regression.
